excerpt: The MBSR group included 17 meditation-naive participants in an 8-week course that met once weekly for 3 h and assigned 30 min of daily sitting meditation. The retreat group participated in a full-time 1-month residential mindfulness retreat, had prior concentrative meditation experience ranging from 4 to 360 months, and engaged in formal mindfulness meditation practices for 10-12 h per day.
overview: These participant and training descriptions ground the comparison between novice MBSR participants, experienced retreat participants, and meditation-naive controls. They matter because the authors interpret different ANT changes as consequences of different training histories and practice intensities. The evidence also marks a limitation: groups differed not only in intervention type but also in prior experience and training dose.
title: Training Group Doses
